settings.label: Text setting
settings.description: A free-text setting whose default pre-fills it. Optional: it may be cleared; the Verifier then receives an empty string.

settings.label: Number setting (bounded, decimal)
settings.description: A numeric setting with a lower and an upper bound (0 to 100) and a step of 0.5. Required: it must always hold a valid value.

settings.label: Number setting (lower bound only, integer)
settings.description: A numeric setting bounded from below only (at least 0), with the default step of 1, so integers only. Required: it must always hold a valid value.

settings.label: Select setting
settings.description: A dropdown of predefined options; the Verifier receives the chosen option's id. Required: its default preselects an option.

settings.label: Select setting (optional)
settings.description: A dropdown of predefined options that may be cleared back to no value. Optional: the Verifier then receives an empty string.

settings.label: Boolean setting
settings.description: A toggle; the Verifier receives true or false. It always has a value, so it has no required flag and must declare a default.

settings.label: Pass verification
settings.description: Whether the mock run passes. Off: the run and every statement are reported as not proven.

variables.description: A Verifier variable: a name this Verifier's conditions may reference. Its type is passed through to the Verifier as-is.
